title: Fear Only Your Creator, Who Is The Protector
body:
Dastoor yaa Sayyidee, madad yaa Sultanu 'l-Awliyaa. (Mawlana Shaykh stands)
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Kareem Allah.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Subhaan Allah.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Sultaan Allah.
Rabbuna wa Rabbu 'l-`Alameen Khaaliquna wa Khaaliqu kulli shayi. Raziquna wa Raziqu kulli shayi, fi 'lmulki wa 'l-malakoot. Yaa Maliku 'l-Mulk anta Maliku 'l-Muluk, zid Habeebika Sayyidi 'l-Awwaleen wa ’l`Akhireen, sharraftahu an yakoona khalifata mina 'l-azal ila 'l-abad, Sayyidi 'l-Awwaleen wa ’l-`Akhireen,
Sayyidina Muhammad (s), Yaa Rasoolullah shafa`atak, shafa`a! Yaa anbiya, shafa`at and your blessings and
intercessions! Allah, Allah. (Mawlana Shaykh sits) Fatihah.
A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. (Mawlana Shaykh stands)
Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. (Mawlana Shaykh sits) Allah, Allah, `Azeez Allah.
As-salaamu `alaykum, our attenders from ins and jinn, who have been authorized to speak, to address

through holy people to everything that is giving its listening. They must listen, and they must hear. Only
Shaytan and its followers are not taking any care, but I think that Shaytan is going to become like wind and
holy ones are going to be victorious! We are victorious because we are running to keep the holy orders of
Heavens. We are going to be victorious. All nations of Mankind that are never listening are, subhaanAllahi 'l`Aliyyu 'l-`Adheem, they are going to be wind. They will be like a leaf in the wind. All of Shaytan's followers
are going to be like leaves in front of strong, gusty wind, with no chance for them to be victorious. Victory is
only for The One and His representative. (Mawlana Shaykh stands) Our Lord Allah Almighty is victorious
from pre-Eternal up to Eternal, and the Eternal sultanate is only for Him! (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
O People! Don't be cheated by Shaytan and shaytanic tricks. Finished! Shaytan and its followers will be
maghlook, defeated, with no chance. The chance to be victorious is for those following the Seal of Prophets
(s)! (Mawlana Shaykh stands) Sayyidina Muhammad (s) is always victorious!! (Mawlana Shaykh sits) We are
not fearing from Shaytan or shaytanic tricks or traps that make people run after that one. No, victorious is
Allah, Jalla Jalaaluh.
O our Attenders! You must understand that point; if not, you will be swept away with a brush. Don't think
that you can say the whole Earth is under our command, that everything is going to be as we like, no! You will
see very soon who has real power and who has been cheated by shaytanic agents! We are warning everyone
from Mankind and from jinns also, to come on the Right Way and leave wrong ways, to be under heavenly
protection. There is no chance for those running on wrong ways to be saved here or Hereafter.
This is a humble meeting, but its power is such that it is surrounding the whole world! If the Lord of Heavens
is asking to give power to an ant against the whole world, that ant is going to become a gigantic ant and
swallow this world! Don't say it can't be. Yes, it can be! One small ant by the heavenly command, "Be!" can
become 70 times bigger than this planet and swallow it!
••••••• ••••••••••••• •••••••••• ••••••• ••••• ••••••• •••••••••• ••••••• •••• ••• •••••••••
Wa idhaa qadaa amran fa innamaa yaqoolu lahu kun fayakoon, And when He decrees an affair, He but says
to it ‘Be’ and becomes. (2:117)
This is Allah Almighty's command. If He says to a small ant, “Become so big that you can swallow this world
with seven more,” it will happen, as that is the Lord of Creation, Who can do anything! Huwa `ala kulli

shayin qadeer.
O Salafi `Ulamas! Where are you, to make a commentary on the holy verse:
••••••••• ••••••• •••••••• ••••••••• •••••• ••••• ••••• •••••• •••••••
wa huwa `ala kulli shayin qadeer, And He has Power over all things. (67:1)
I never heard from those who claim they are Salafi `ulamas, or doctors of Shari`ah, or Azhari ash-Shareef
`ulamas to speak on that ayatu 'l-kareema. And the missions of `ulamas, what is that? We ask from `ulamas
to teach us! What are they teaching people? That is the most important thing we must know and believe, and
to hear it in Khutbat al-Jumu`ah, the Friday speech: “O People! huwa `ala kulli shayin qadeer.” You `ulamas
only know how to say, Kullu muhdath bida` tun wa kullu bida`tun dalaala, wa kullu dalaalata fi 'n-naar! For
what are you speaking such things? Do you know the reality in Islam of muhdath, innovation? You are
bringing so many things, saying they are "new innovations." Will you say a tree is not a real tree because it is
not reaching by its roots to Earth? Why don't you leave that and say what is necessary now for Muslims and
for mu`mins? Mu`mins now are trembling! What do they fear? Say! Why are you not reminding Muslims
that nothing can be in this world without heavenly permission, without heavenly commands? And now
Muslims everywhere fear western people's weapons, and they will do everything to be under this world!
O Salafi `ulamas! Also you fear nuclear weapons. Why? You think only when on Hajj people put their hands
on the honored place of Nabi (s) and you say it is shirk! Why you are not saying to your commanders, your
sultans, your governments and presidents that are trembling from nuclear powers, are those weapons more
powerful than the Lord of Heavens? Why are you not saying? Allah Almighty is saying, wa dhakkir, "and
remind," so say!
“My servants, fattaqoonee, fear only Me!” (Mawlana Shaykh stands) Asta`eedhu billah. Is it ayatulkareemah? Why are you not saying? You are Arabs! fattaqoonee. (Mawlana Shaykh sits) Ittaqoo, from
nuclear weapons. Why are you not saying? When people come and say something to Rasoolullah (s), you run
after them and say they are mushrik! Why you don't know this, and you claim you are amr bi 'l-m`aroof wa
nahiyy `ani 'l-munkar jama`at (group for calling to what is good and forbidding what is evil). Why are you
leaving the most important things and running after some no-meaning subjects? Why are you not saying this

important reminder to people? Why are you not advising to heads of your nations that Allah Almighty is
saying, fattaqooni? What is the meaning of fattaqoonee? But you are not going to fear from Allah Almighty,
you are fearing from western nuclear weapons, making you full of fear and your life full of unhappiness.
And Allah Almighty promised His servants a hayyatun tayyibah. What is hayyatun tayyibah? You are Arabs;
why are you not saying hayyatun tayyibah? That is a lifestyle of khawfun `alayhim, no fear for them. Wa laa
hum yahzunoon, and also they are not going to be sad. Why are you not saying? You are quarreling with that
shaykh who is speaking something daily and throwing it on our Salafi `ulamas and followers from no-mind,
Wahabi people! Why aren't the Wahabi people saying this? Why the Salafi `ulamas go to America, to London,
and to Europe? Why are they not going to established Islamic territories? We say, "We are here and not
afraid of you. We fear our Lord, Who promises us a life where there is la khawfun `alayhim wa laa hum
yahzanoon."
Those who keep the advises of the Holy Qur'an will be in safety and will be happy, here and Hereafter. I am a
heavenly guarantor for you on this! The Lord of Heavens is saying to His most beloved one, Sayyidi 'lAwwaleen wa ’l-`Akhireen (s), "Say to them to fear Me alone." Where are Islam's `ulamas? Allah is going to
ask you! Ajaa`ib, it is astonishing that you fear that one from this one, but they are not reminding the Muslim
world, "O Muslims! Don't fear anything except your Lord, Allah Almighty.” (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits)
Why are you are not teaching? Chiefs of every religion and their holiest ones in the east and west are they not
giving such a daily declaration, “O People! Don't fear from nuclear bombs. If the Lord of Heavens is asking to
reach you with His heavenly punishment, no one can prevent it. But if He is asking to protect His servants,
nothing can harm them."
O People! Are you understanding, or am I speaking to rocks? Don't think your money is enough for you.
Some people are so proud of their billions, fearing nuclear bombs and looking to their wealth, “How can we
keep it? If one nuclear bomb comes, our sultanate it is going to be nothing! It will disappear!" They are
trembling from nuclear bombs but they are not trembling from their Lord, Almighty Allah, Who is saying,
fattaqooni, fattaqooni, “Fear only Me, not anything else. I am the Protector, Hafiz, of everything. Why you are
fearing? If I send you a small creature that you cannot see or hear, that is making glorification, because
nothing is going to be alive without glorification of their Lord."

And if you do what your Lord is saying; glorifying Him, you will be under the holy wings of angels here and
Hereafter. If you are not doing so, then why are you saying, “That is mushrik.” Why are you saying, “It is
ignorant.” For what? And you are getting angry if someone is dhakkirhum, reminding of such things, you are
never going to be happy. Why are you are not mentioning in khutbah every Jumu`ah that,“ O Believers, you
must believe that Allah Almighty is wa huwa ‘ala kulli shay'in qadir (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits) Don't
be fearful except from your Creator, from your most Glorious and Majestic Lord of Creation! You must only
fear for Him and nothing else. Nothing can harm you if your Creator is not giving permission! Why are you
not saying, “Allah Almighty is saying, wa huwa ‘ala kulli shay'in qadir.”
If Allah Almighty is saying, “Make down ahl ash-shirk wal nifaq wal kufr,” then who can prevent Him? No
one can prevent Him, for He will always be victorious, a winner! But you can't be victorious and winners if
you are not believing in His endless Power Oceans. Make people fear only from their Creator! Every Jumu`ah
you must say, “O People! Be in peace from everything, because our Lord, our Creator, is our Protector. If He
says that He can protect everything, He can do it, because He is that One Who says, wa huwa ‘ala kulli shayiin
qadir, "I can do everything as I like!” Why are you not teaching this? Teach what is the meaning of, wa huwa
`ala kulli shay'in qadir. But you are you trembling from nuclear bombs and missiles of western countries?
Don’t worry! They are not going to touch people whose belief is strong. But for those whose belief is not
strong, or it is not real belief, they will be taken away by the worst weapons of western countries! They (the
western countries) are also going to be destroyed, as the Islamic territories are being destroyed because they
are not believing in the endless Power Oceans of their Lord, Allah Almighty. May Allah forgive us.
O People! As-salaamu `alaykum! Yaa Saahibu 'z-Zamaan! As-salaamu `alaykum yaa Qutbu 'l-Mutasarrif. If
something is wrong, if someone is going to speak, my masters are responsible. I don't think they will be
giving me a short time for tazkir, reminding all nations of ins and jinn, from Mankind. Be in peace in your
heart of Allah Almighty's endless Power Oceans and run to Him. And He is the only One Who can protect you
from Shaytan and shaytanic agents. O Shaytan and Shaytan's followers, you will be wind, defeated! If there
are remaining on this planet only three people, even then victory will be for them, not for you. Don't be
cheated by billions of people who are running after you and are using such foolish technology. Don’t think
that is giving harm to the real ones from servants. May Allah forgive us.
Fatihah.

(40 minutes) SubhaanAllah, sometimes making them to fear. We must fear from Allah Almighty only, not
from those people. We must not fear from Shaytan and shaytanic groups. Astaghfirullah.
Fatihah.
That is the barakah, blessings of the holy month of the Seal of Prophets, Sayyidina Muhammad (s). (Mawlana
Shaykh stands and sits) Shabaan Mu`azzam.
(Mawlana Shaykh prays two rakaats Salat ash-Shukr)
